headline: Review of Summer Racial Justice Academy recommendations, teacher hiring strategy, and restorative practices planning.
summary: The committee will hear recommendations from the Summer Racial Justice Academy, discuss a strategy to improve hiring and retention of teachers of the global majority, and talk about restorative and anti-racist practice plans for the coming year. Members will also discuss access to AP and BTC classes and plan the next meeting's agenda.
items: Autumn Bangoura presents recommendations of the Summer Racial Justice Academy; Committee Q&A
Priority Area 4 strategy to improve hiring practices and retention of teachers of the global majority
Commissioner Ericksen reports on her review of topics with Executive Director Sparks to help set next year's DEIC agenda
Side discussion on equal access to AP classes and BTC classes, to be raised once data are reviewed
Priority Area 5 on Restorative Practices and anti-racist practices: plan to reach out to ED Lauren K and BHS principal about plans for the coming year
location: Sustainability Academy - Community Room, 123 North Street
